acceptanceCovered: GET /api/articles/:slug/comments is public and supports an optional valid token; missing articles return 404, invalid optional tokens return 401, and success returns { comments }.

Comments are ordered by createdAt ASC then id ASC; author following is false anonymously and reflects the authenticated viewer using one batched follow lookup; serialization exposes only public fields.

Article existence and comment rows are read in one REPEATABLE READ transaction so concurrent article deletion cannot produce a mixed-snapshot response; persistence failures return the generic documented 500 response.
Generated Swagger and static OpenAPI describe optional authentication, success, 401, 404, and 500 contracts; the PR adds only the GET comments API.
regressionChecked: Existing POST comments Swagger and response behavior remain intact.
Malformed optional tokens return 401; missing articles return 404.
The query orders by created_at and ID, while following state is loaded in one batched query.
Comments expose no internal author ID, email, or password hash.
Article and comments reads share a REPEATABLE READ snapshot.
